name: halyard
description: Durable directed-workflow runner with a visual editor and a PostgreSQL worker.

scripts.test: npm run test -w @halyard/core && npm run test -w @halyard/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @halyard/core && npm run typecheck -w @halyard/server && npm run typecheck -w @halyard/web && npm run typecheck -w @halyard/fixture
scripts.build: npm run build -w @halyard/server && npm run build -w @halyard/web
